detail: no packing of 49 strips could be wired at any candidate height; every pack the sweep produced left nets unrouted. That is a PACKER defect -- it is producing packs its own router cannot wire -- and it is reported rather than papered over with a looser packing

the 30s deadline passed with no completed packing of 115 strips; 3 packs were routed in that time and the best of them still left 4 nets unrouted (worst 39), so a longer clock alone would not have wired this spec. This is a REFUSAL and not a verdict on the spec
